Remove or clean modules using the material-specific validated method
verification: Rotor path free of foreign matter
Blank run meets carryover and vibration criteria
prohibited_methods: Reach-in clearing with residual motion or stored energy
Wet cleaning without electrical, corrosion, drainage, and drying authorization

Clean from dirty side to captured destination

Opening a pressurized or dusty path

accessibility_requirements.subject: Loading and unloading
accessibility_requirements.requirement: Document reach, height, required force, grip, dexterity, removable mass, and spill behavior for every user interface.
accessibility_requirements.verification: Measure interfaces and test representative users and foreseeable loads without exposing a hazardous boundary.
open_questions: What target user population and jurisdiction define the envelope?

accessibility_requirements.subject: Safety-critical status
accessibility_requirements.requirement: Directly indicate motion, pressure, temperature, atmosphere, access permission, and latched fault through appropriate redundant sensory channels.
accessibility_requirements.verification: Status-comprehension tests under noise, glare, limited vision, limited hearing, and interrupted attention.
open_questions: Which states require tactile indication or physical lock position?

accessibility_requirements.subject: Controls and emergency stop
accessibility_requirements.requirement: Provide locally reachable controls with distinguishable purpose, bounded force, no dependence on remote service, and no unintended restart.
accessibility_requirements.verification: Reach, force, identification, command-feedback, and power-restoration tests in the specified installation.
open_questions: How many emergency-stop stations are required by enclosure size and approach paths?

accessibility_requirements.subject: Children, pets, and visitors
accessibility_requirements.requirement: Prevent reach, climbing instability, entrapment, unintended start, and opening of hazardous paths without relying solely on warnings or passwords.
accessibility_requirements.verification: Dimensional reach, probe, entrapment, stability, and foreseeable-misuse evaluation against the final product category.
open_questions: Which domestic product standards supply the applicable probes and loads?

accessibility_requirements.subject: Fault recovery
accessibility_requirements.requirement: Present the safe next action without requiring diagnosis, while preserving uncertainty and service boundaries.
accessibility_requirements.verification: Scenario tests for jam, full bin, sensor fault, containment fault, power restoration, and refused input.
open_questions: Which faults permit user recovery and which require service or evacuation?

installation_requirements.subject: Anchoring and stability
installation_requirements.requirement: Specify the foundation, anchors, leveling, center-of-mass envelope, tip and slide resistance, and transmitted dynamic loads.
installation_requirements.verification: Structural calculation and installation inspection followed by bounded vibration and disturbance tests.
open_questions: Which building constructions and seismic regions are admitted?

installation_requirements.subject: Clearance and exclusion
installation_requirements.requirement: Preserve service, cooling, exhaust, emergency, and credible-fragment or release clearances without relying on movable household storage.
installation_requirements.verification: Measured site inspection against the configuration-specific installation manifest.
open_questions: Does the final containment basis require an occupied-area exclusion zone?

installation_requirements.subject: Electrical supply and isolation
installation_requirements.requirement: Define supply, protection, grounding, bonding, isolation, ingress, emergency disconnection, and restart behavior for the target jurisdiction.
installation_requirements.verification: Inspection and electrical tests mapped to the selected product category and installation rules.
open_questions: What product classification and supply architecture apply?

installation_requirements.subject: Air and exhaust
installation_requirements.requirement: Define makeup air, normal and emergency exhaust destination, backflow prevention, pressure interaction, filtration, noise, and forbidden shared paths.
installation_requirements.verification: Air-balance, pressure, capture, leak, backflow, and noise tests in the installed configuration.
open_questions: Which material classes prohibit recirculation or require external discharge?

installation_requirements.subject: Drainage and water
installation_requirements.requirement: Physically segregate food, general process, hazardous quarantine, and building drainage; prevent uncontrolled cleaning discharge and backflow.
installation_requirements.verification: Route inspection, tracer test, backflow test, and review of authorized effluent for each process.
open_questions: Which processes must remain dry or use replaceable contained modules?

installation_requirements.subject: Environment and external events
installation_requirements.requirement: Set admitted temperature, humidity, dust, flood, fire, vibration, altitude, and power-quality envelopes with post-event inspection rules.
installation_requirements.verification: Environmental specification review and bounded tests appropriate to the final installation class.
open_questions: Which external events are resisted, detected, or treated as retirement events?
